description: Check whether a claim has enough tracked evidence and, for parseable factual claims (row counts, file lines/bytes/existence, versions), recheck configured SQLite/filesystem/JSON verifiers before the agent asserts it.

claim.description: The claim text to verify (e.g. "the row count is 1,284" or "all tests pass")

goalContract.description: Optional agent handoff contract. Use this when a worker/orchestrator/reviewer loop needs explicit done criteria before a done/fixed/shipped claim is allowed.

doneWhen.description: Human-readable acceptance criteria for the task.

goal.description: The operator-visible goal this claim is trying to close.

mustNotChange.description: Protected areas or constraints the agents must preserve while completing the goal.

orchestratorAgent.description: Agent responsible for routing and deciding whether done can be claimed.

proveBy.description: Tracked action ids required before the claim can pass, such as tests_passed, review_completed, ci_green, deploy_verified, or operator_approved.

name: verify_claim
title: Verify Claim
